memoryRule: a committed contiguous range becomes a vertical pressure fibre and actual counterform; every other DOM token is re-produced around the accumulated voids; four cuts compound and lift exactly
interaction: pointer/touch drag a contiguous span and cut it, plus ArrowLeft/ArrowRight and Enter equivalent
medium: deterministic browser DOM typography with CSS writing modes and generated counterform apertures
primitiveBudget: one generated 24-token letter inventory, contiguous pressure spans, four actual counterform apertures, and four liftable DOM reflows
commitThreshold: one contiguous range of three to six letters followed by an explicit cut; short, occupied, or unknown ranges remain geometry-neutral
interactionRule: pointer/touch drag across a contiguous span; cut commits; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight chooses a span and Enter/Space cuts; Delete lifts latest; Escape/R releases
representationRupture: Canvas phrase population, carrier beam, and SVG route body -> browser DOM letter inventory with CSS writing-mode fibres and actual counterforms
compositionRupture: three-line phrase, single beam, and route constellation -> tall uneven register with central apertures and two re-packing margins
encounterRupture: ordered witness taps, material drag, and route traversal -> native selection-like range drag followed by an explicit cut
temporalRupture: reading-axis witness order and route rewiring -> occupied pressure intervals that accumulate as persistent voids and refuse overlap
mediumRupture: Canvas glyph agents and SVG paths -> DOM nodes, CSS writing modes, transforms, and generated aperture geometry
changedRule: A held contiguous span is geometry-neutral. Cutting it turns the span into a vertical pressure fibre and an actual counterform; the entire remaining inventory is re-produced around the void rather than receiving a local mark.
visibleConsequence: The blind view begins as a dark three-column letter inventory. A valid cut opens a real aperture and re-packs every survivor along two margins while the selected span changes writing mode; four counterforms persist.
falsifier: Delete if the cut only moves or recolours selected letters, if the void is an overlay, if short or occupied spans commit, if later cuts reset, if lifting is inexact, or if the blind inventory reads as a generic grid.
deletionCondition: Delete v046 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish a material counterform and DOM reflow from v041-v045's gap, route, carrier, and collective-axis grammars.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
